_evidence: Car record behind esi for 0x0042df3a (lane/side code returned in eax): byte +0x7a bit 7 selects the early 5; word +0xea is compared with 0 (je), its sign (jns) and the equality selectors -8, 8, 0x10, 0x18 (each je), so it is drawn from those values plus their neighbours and extremes (every return code occurs); byte +0xfe bits 0x40/0x10 and the sign of word +0x94 decide the zero-offset path (random fill covers them). No pointers or divisors: every pattern is valid.
